inputs.request: Read-only worker-closure/v1 matrix over four independent semantic work shapes: a planless same-context owner, a plan-backed task child, an eligible fresh-child attempt two, and an admitted Build-repair worker. Preserve the same owner or child, task, attempt, unchanged Task Contract, target, and closure identity from candidate through closure. In mandatory round one, check correctness, preservation, effects, and owned acceptance; reconsider the first-sufficient solution ladder and candidate-local structural regression; and inspect only changed permanent tests. Seed (a) a directly evidenced acceptance violation whose in-boundary correctness repair adds code or complexity, (b) an unrepairable-under-authority correctness violation, (c) a qualified structural quality proposal with an exact smaller replacement and preservation proof, (d) an otherwise similar unqualified quality proposal, (e) a redundant changed-test merge with proof, and (f) an unqualified test proposal. Exercise no-correction, correctness-correction, and quality-correction branches with round counts 1, 2, and 2. Round two checks only actual corrections and plausible correction-caused regressions; reject a third round and unaffected-work reopening. Settle unique keep, redundant merge, unsupported remove, and sufficient-existing-coverage no-new-contract branches before smoke; read no untouched portfolio test. Smoke follows closure and test settlement, then exactly one Common Handoff. Mechanical roots, neutral integration, verification, final review, continual learning, audit controllers, and audit opinions run no worker closure.
